guide-entry-af85fa65a59bcb8c2882bd7f.description: Review of the debate on the topic in the Sixth Committee of the General Assembly, and of the previous work of the Commission and other international legal bodies. Examination of the scope, content and legal status of article 36 of the articles on responsibility of States for internationally wrongful acts. Examination of the scope of the topic, including internationally wrongful acts, compensation for the damage caused and scope ratione personae. Identification of issues and questions to be examined. Review of relevant judicial decisions and State practice. Discussion of the possible form of work and organization and schedule of work. First report of the Special Rapporteur , Mr. Mārtiņš Paparinskis ( 77th session of the ILC (2026)) A/CN.4/793
